const nextSlide = () => { setCurrentSlide((prev) => prev === slides.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1 ); }; const previousSlide = () => { setCurrentSlide((prev) => prev === 0 ? slides.length - 1 : prev - 1 ); }; return (
